summary: Frontend-only regression run for IMS Audit Framework upgrade. Executed 12 scenario groups across Standards Library, Audit Templates, new template audit (17-section Full IMS), Help drawer edit/save, finding dialog (4 tabs / status/risk/samples/validation), Asset Registers, Audit Dashboard, Legacy audit navigation. ~85% of targeted flows PASS. Two real defects found: (1) Audit LOCK does not reflect in UI (banner never appears; state does not persist on reload) although backend POST /lock returns 200 and writes an audit_trail entry — GET /api/audits/{id} response appears to omit/not update the `locked` field on the audit_reports document; (2) Legacy audit AR-2025-026 could not be opened via list card click — the eye/view button click did not navigate (list uses stateful onClick on icon-only <button>s, no data-testid on cards / no anchor href), so full legacy regression (clause rendering, Management Review→Performance Evaluation help mapping, legacy finding save) is UNVERIFIED via UI. Also: minor mixed-content warnings (some XHRs default to http:// for /api/settings/) — non-blocking but should be fixed.

critical.issue: Endpoint returns 200 and writes audit_trail entry (audit_locked), but the audit_reports document does not appear to reflect locked=true on subsequent GET — banner never renders, state does not persist across reload. Verified for both AR-2026-005 (new template audit) and AR-2026-003. Backend code at audit_routes.py:453-462 sets locked:True in $set — investigate why GET /api/audits/{id} returns locked=None (serializer masking? current_user None? projection?).

ui_bugs.issue: audit-locked-banner never appears after clicking audit-lock-btn (confirm dialog accepted, POST /lock returns 200). audit-reopen-btn also does not appear. Reload does not restore locked state.

Audit list cards do not expose an anchor/link or data-testid for navigation; the view (eye) icon button click via JS does not navigate to the detail page. Blocks legacy AR-2025-026 e2e regression via UI. Consider adding data-testid="audit-view-{id}" and/or wrapping the card in a <Link>.

Some XHRs (/api/settings/, /api/timezone) are fired with http:// under an https page and get blocked by browser Mixed Content policy. Non-blocking but noisy console errors. Fix baseURL to use protocol-relative or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exactly.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend POST /audits/{id}/lock succeeds but subsequent GET reflects no locked state, so UI never transitions to locked mode.
Cannot navigate to /quality/audits/{legacyId} from list card — no clickable link; only trash / download / eye icon buttons without proper testids or href.

issues: Help drawer overlays the finding dialog when both are opened — pointer-events overlay from finding-dialog intercepts clicks inside the drawer edit form (only triggered when opening drawer while dialog remains mounted). Consider closing peer overlays.

action_items: Fix audit LOCK persistence — investigate why GET /api/audits/{id} does not surface locked=true after POST /lock (likely a serializer/response-model omission or MongoDB doc missing 'locked' field on some records).

Add data-testid + real anchor navigation to audit list cards (e.g., data-testid='audit-view-{id}') so eye button click navigates to /quality/audits/{id}. Currently blocks legacy audit regression via UI.
Fix mixed-content HTTP calls to /api/settings and /api/timezone (blocked by browser under HTTPS).
(Nice-to-have) Prevent Help drawer and Finding dialog from being mounted simultaneously to avoid overlay pointer-events conflict.
critical_code_review_comments: AuditReportDetail.js grew large — consider extracting HelpDrawer, FindingDialog, LockReopen and Trail into separate components under /components/audit.
lockAudit() in AuditReportDetail.js doesn't error-handle the POST response — silent failures result in stale UI. Wrap in try/catch and toast on error.

Backend audit_routes.py lock_audit sets 'locked: True' but no read-side test validates this — add a test that POSTs lock then GETs the audit and asserts locked==True (current backend test only checks status code and downstream 423).

rca of the issue: LOCK/UNLOCK UI regression: POST /api/audits/{id}/lock returns 200 (per supervisor backend log) and audit_trail records 'audit_locked'. But GET /api/audits/{id} response returned by the endpoint shows locked=None (verified via curl of the same audit id). Frontend fetches after lock and reads audit.locked which is falsy -> banner and reopen-btn never render. Root cause likely lives in either (a) the audit GET response model / serializer stripping the `locked` field, or (b) the update_one $set path silently failing due to a missing/renamed collection or query mismatch (though the trail write path succeeds in the same handler, so this is less likely). Reproduce: 1) login as admin, open any audit detail page, 2) click Lock Audit and accept the confirm, 3) verify backend log shows 200 on /lock, 4) reload the page, 5) observe: 'Lock Audit' button still present, banner not visible, and curl of GET /api/audits/{id} returns locked=None. Mitigation: ensure the GET serializer includes `locked`, `locked_by`, `locked_at`; and add a backend test that lock->GET returns locked==True.
